title: Candid Late-Night Pizza Moment with Handheld Camcorder Aesthetic
content:
A dim bedroom lit by a harsh on-camera flash. White bedsheets fill most of the frame, slightly wrinkled and textured. An open pizza box sits nearby on the bed, its lid tilted back, revealing a partially eaten pizza.

A young woman lies on her back across the bed, head tilted slightly toward the camera. She wears a playful shirt patterned with cartoon pizza slices. Her hair spreads across the pillow.

The camera is held very close above her with a wide consumer lens, creating slight perspective distortion. The flash flattens shadows and creates glossy highlights on her eyes and the pizza grease.

She lifts a slice of pepperoni pizza above her face.

Slowly, she lowers it toward her mouth.

The cheese stretches slightly from the slice as it moves. Oil glistens on the pepperoni under the flash. The slice bends naturally as gravity pulls the tip downward.

She takes a bite.

The crust compresses between her fingers. The cheese pulls and separates unevenly as she bites through it. A small strand of melted cheese briefly stretches before snapping.

Her eyes remain fixed toward the camera as she chews.

The camera remains very close and handheld, shifting slightly as if the person filming adjusts their grip. The flash creates harsh reflections across the pizza box and glossy toppings.

Image quality shows consumer analog artifacts: visible grain, slight color noise in darker areas, mild softness, and faint exposure fluctuation.

The camera lingers as she continues eating casually, the pizza slice slowly disappearing bite by bite.

Overall feeling: intimate, playful, and candid — a messy late-night pizza moment captured with a handheld camcorder in a pre-digital bedroom setting.

Time: [00:00 - 00:15] Scene: Crowded and dull open-plan office area.

You’ll sit in this cubicle until you die and still won't afford my bag. We were colleagues, now get out yourself.” Micro-expressions: Manager Wang greasily shoves Li Ze's shoulder. Li Ze lowers his head, fists clenched tightly, veins bulging.

Act 2: The Return of the King (The Return)
Time: [00:15 - 00:30] Scene: Company main conference room, all employees lined up, waiting for the new boss.
[00:15-00:20] Camera Movement:
The conference room door is violently slammed open by bodyguards. The camera gives a slow-motion shot (Slow Motion) of Li Ze walking in, wearing a bespoke suit and radiating powerful aura.
[00:20-00:25] Key Change: Crowd Reaction
The camera quickly scans the ordinary employees on both sides of the conference table:
Someone is about to applaud the welcome, sees it's Li Ze, their hand freezes mid-air, mouth wide open into an “O” shape.
Two male colleagues who used to mock Li Ze exchange terrified glances, quickly lower their heads pretending to look at documents, trembling.
The whispering instantly disappears, the whole room is dead silent, only the sound of Li Ze's leather shoes on the floor.
[00:25-00:30] Action and Close-up: Su Qian was originally tidying her hair, preparing to fawn, but the moment she sees Li Ze, her pupils contract violently, and she instinctively steps back, hitting a chair.
Li Ze ignores everyone's gaze, walks straight to the main seat, pulls out the chair, and sits down calmly. Li Ze (coldly, surveying the room): “What, don't you recognize me? The entire former management team is dismissed. The surname of this company is now—Li.”

Act 3: The Moment of Reckoning (The Firing)

[00:30-00:35] Action and Manager Wang's Reaction: Su Qian rushes towards the conference table in panic, trying to explain. Key Change: Manager Wang's Reaction
The camera focuses on Manager Wang. He was originally standing arrogantly in the deputy position, but now his legs give way, and he collapses directly onto the floor. He trembles trying to grab the water cup on the table to cover his embarrassment, but his hand shakes too much, the cup overturns with a “pa” sound, spilling water all over his pants, looking utterly miserable.

Li Ze doesn't even look her in the eye, but disgustedly uses two fingers to pick up the 'Termination Notice' from the table and lightly flicks it.
[00:40-00:45] Ending and Dialogue:
The papers scatter like snowflakes over Su Qian and the collapsed Manager Wang. Li Ze stands up, straightens his cuff, his eyes icy cold. Li Ze (word by word):
“I bought this company for a deep clean. My territory has no room for trash.”
Action:
After speaking, Li Ze walks away quickly without looking at the floor. Visual Treatment:
The camera focuses on Li Ze's resolute back, the only background sound is the heavy closing of the door—“BANG!” (Screen goes black, no subtitles, ends with white space)

title: Deadpan Absurdist Comedy Video Prompt
content:
A street food vendor in his 40s, broad shoulders, white apron, red bandana headband, stands behind a wok on a night market stall. Just as he prepares a dramatic toss, his phone starts ringing in his pocket. Without hesitation he flips the vegetables and sauce into the air in a perfect arc above the wok under a burst of flame, and at the same moment pulls out his phone and answers it.

Camera holds tight from the side on the arc above the wok. As the vegetables reach the apex, they suddenly stop — suspended mid-air. Every droplet of sauce and every vegetable piece hangs frozen in a precise sculptural formation above the wok.

Calmly on the phone, the vendor says: “Okay, I’ll do it. I’m in the middle of something right now. I’ll do it after five minutes.” He hangs up.

He checks his watch. He leans forward and examines the suspended arc from different angles, hands behind his back. He pokes one suspended carrot. It stays. He shrugs, reaches up, and rearranges a few pieces into a more aesthetically pleasing formation. Steps back. Assesses. Nods.

Finally he casually taps the suspended arc. The vegetables and sauce instantly drop back down into the wok and continue cooking as if nothing happened.

Night market warm sodium and neon lighting, steam from surrounding stalls. Deadpan absurdist comedy, freeze-frame physics, precise timing, photorealistic, 4K.

- Negative: No text, no people, no camera reflections, no dust or scratches, avoid organic textures, no clumsy movement, no background interference

title: First-Person Perspective Couple Interaction Video Prompt
content:
First-person male perspective, on the living room sofa, a young woman (facial image reference @【@Image 1】) is lying on her side wearing loose white pajamas, one hand supporting her head, the other holding a phone and scrolling through videos. Her legs are casually draped over the armrest of the sofa, exposing her fair calves and ankles. She is focused on the screen, occasionally smiling.

The main viewpoint (viewer) is sitting next to her, watching her relaxed state, and can't help but reach out and gently touch her calf. The moment the fingertip touches her skin—

She instantly shudders, almost dropping her phone, and abruptly turns her head, eyes wide, looking at the viewer. A hint of panic and surprise flashes in her eyes, and her mouth is slightly open, as if startled.

However, the next second, her expression changes dramatically. The corners of her mouth slowly curl up, and her eyes narrow slightly, revealing a meaningful, mischievous smile. She slowly puts down her phone, sits upright, and stares at the viewer as if she has discovered something interesting.

Before the main viewpoint can react, she suddenly leans forward, lunging directly toward the viewer. She presses her hands against the viewer's chest, pressing her entire body onto them, pushing the viewer back against the sofa cushion. She stares closely into the viewer's eyes, her smile deepening.

The main viewpoint is flustered by this sudden action, their body stiff, hands hovering in the air, afraid to touch her. They stammer nervously: “Wait, wait a minute… you misunderstood, I didn’t mean anything by it…”

She just smiles and leans closer, remaining silent.

The scene is the living room, warm-toned home lighting, shallow depth of field, with the focus concentrated on her expression changes and the lunging action. title: Universal Cinematic Video Script/Prompt Framework
content:
Scene 1 0–2s Extreme close-up.
In the early morning, an elderly person's hands slowly push a bowl of hot tea across a bluestone table. Steam curls up, merging with the thin morning mist outside the window. The scene is tranquil, with a breathing rhythm.

Scene 2 2–5s Low-angle wide shot.
The camera is close to the wet bluestone path. A line of figures slowly walks out from the depths of the alley. Old walls on both sides are covered with moss, and red lanterns gently sway in the morning breeze. Light pours in from the alley entrance, backlit, with golden dust floating.

Scene 3 5–8s Medium shot, slow push-in.
A young woman stands alone by the Dujiangyan water, staring blankly at the surging river that has flowed for a thousand years. The hem of her clothes is lifted by the wind, the sound of the river drowns out everything else. The camera slowly orbits, the world is vast, and the person appears small yet resolute.

Scene 4 8–11s Fast montage, approximately 0.5 seconds per frame
A stunning freeze frame of the face-changing performance / A lazy panda looking up directly at the camera / Candlelight flickering in Wuhou Shrine illuminating ancient stone carvings / Jinli at night, crowded with people and fireworks filling the sky. Each frame has intense colors, editing like drum beats.

Scene 5 11–13s Dusk.
A boy leans on the window sill of a teahouse, resting his chin on his hand, watching people come and go on the street, a slight smile on his lips. Inside the old teahouse, the local dialect is soft, the sound of mahjong tiles clacking, time seems to have never left this place. Handheld camera, gentle and real.

Scene 6 13–15s Drone slowly ascends.
Chengdu under the night sky, thousands of lights illuminated, the Jinjiang River winding like a belt, the city, mountains, and plains merging into a magnificent whole. The screen gradually darkens, white subtitles fade in—
Voiceover: “There is a city, once people come, they don't want to leave.” (Pause) “Chengdu, it has always been this way.”
End credits: Chengdu · Leisurely Land of Abundance. Black screen. End.
description: A universal framework (script/prompt) for generating 15-second promotional videos, following a four-part structure: setting the atmosphere (slow), building tension (slow to fast), montage of visual anchors (fast cuts), and a slow, narrative conclusion with text overlay. The example script is for a promotional video about the city of Chengdu. | Author: 沐阳 (https://x.com/yyyole) | Source: https://x.com/yyyole/status/2027763476056445073 | Published: 2026-02-28T15:11:01.000Z

title: Earth's Eye Cinematic Video Prompt
content:
Core concept: Overlooking Earth from space, the camera free-falls toward the surface. After each impact, it bounces up and lands on landmarks across different continents. The bounce trajectories form glowing arc flight paths across the Earth, eventually forming a giant eye.

Real-shot texture combined with surreal visual spectacle, 8K ultra-high definition. The cold blue tones of the space scene naturally transition with the characteristic light and shadow of the ground scenes. Features include realistic atmospheric scattering light, volumetric clouds, and particle effects.

0-2 seconds: Space view, Earth slowly rotating, occupying two-thirds of the right side of the screen. The edge of the atmosphere glows with a golden arc. Silence. The camera suddenly loses control and accelerates toward Earth: a first-person perspective free-fall penetrating the atmosphere. Air friction generates orange-red plasma flames wrapping the lens edges. The screen vibrates violently. A sonic boom explodes as the sound barrier is broken, and clouds tear apart rapidly to the sides.

2-4 seconds: The camera breaks through the clouds. Below is a panoramic view of nighttime Paris. The lights of the Eiffel Tower rapidly enlarge and approach. The camera stops abruptly in the last frame before hitting the tower's spire: Time freezes. The light at the top of the Eiffel Tower pulses once like a heartbeat, releasing a golden shockwave. The shockwave slingshots the camera eastward. The camera transforms into a meteor streaking across the night sky of the European continent. City lights on the ground rapidly recede like a circuit board. The meteor's trail leaves the first glowing arc on the Earth's surface.

4-6 seconds: The meteor camera plunges over Northwest China, passing through a time-lapse night sky of star trails, crashing toward the Great Wall: The camera flies ultra-low, skimming the wall. Bricks on the wall are lifted by the airflow, suspended, and then fall, forming a wave. As it follows and flies over the beacon towers, each tower ignites its signal fire sequentially. The firelight illuminates the surrounding mountains. The camera passes through the flame of the last beacon tower: The orange of the flame gradually transitions to the orange of sunrise. The camera is now above the Taj Mahal in India in the early morning. A top-down shot shows the Taj Mahal's perfectly symmetrical reflection unfolding in the pool like a mandala pattern. The camera spirals down, sucked into the water surface by the reflection.

6-8 seconds: After penetrating the water, the camera flips underwater. When it emerges, it is midday in Rio de Janeiro. The camera captures an upward shot from the sea, silhouetting the Christ the Redeemer statue with arms outstretched against the light. The camera spirals upward, circling the statue, climbing to its height. Lightning spheres begin to condense at the fingertips of the Christ statue. The lightning sphere launches the camera across the Atlantic Ocean: The camera transforms into a chain of lightning leaping between clouds. Each flash of lightning momentarily freezes different landmarks below: Statue of Liberty, Pyramids, Sydney Opera House, Mount Fuji, like a high-speed flash from God's perspective.

8-10 seconds: The final lightning strike propels the camera back into space. title: Whip Pan Dialogue Argument Scene
content:
ARGUMENT - WHIP PAN FOLLOWS SPEAKER
15 Seconds / Continuous Shot / Dynamic Camera

SHOT DESCRIPTION:

Interior. Apartment. Day. WOMAN (30s) and MAN (32) mid-argument. Camera WHIP PANS to follow WHOEVER IS SPEAKING. Clean sequence, no character appears twice in same position.

0:00-0:02
Woman near door.

WOMAN
You promised. You said you'd be here.

0:02-0:04
WOMAN (CONT'D)
Our appointment was at three o'clock.
Where were you?

She steps forward.

Man turns away.

MAN
I got held up at work. It's not a big deal.

0:04-0:06
Eyes wet but controlled anger.

WOMAN
Not a big deal? I took off work.
I rearranged everything.

Shoulders tense. He responds.

MAN
You think I don't know that?
You think I don't feel like shit about it?

0:06-0:08
Voice drops, sharper.

WOMAN
Feeling like shit doesn't change anything.
It doesn't undo it.

man moves toward her. Defensive posture breaking.

MAN
What do you want from me? An apology?
Fine. I'm sorry.

0:08-0:10
Her face hardens. Sadness beneath anger.

WOMAN
I don't want apologies anymore, David.

man stops moving. Her words hit different.

WOMAN (CONT'D)
(from off-screen, but camera on man)
I want you.

Silence stretches. His face changes.

0:10-0:12
Man opens mouth to respond.

OVERSHOOTS past woman, continues past apartment door into hallway beyond.

0:12-0:15
WHIP PAN CONTINUES, unmotivated, chaotic, through open doorway across hallway.

Lands on: Apartment door cracked open. Inside: GOLDEN RETRIEVER PUPPY (4 months, fluffy, confused).

PUPPY's head tilts. One ear up, one ear sideways. Looking directly at camera. Confused. Concerned. Like it heard the argument and doesn't understand why two humans are sad.

HOLD on puppy's face. Blinks slowly. Eyes innocent.

SOUND: Argument stops. Only puppy's small breathing. Silence.

TECHNICAL:

- Camera: Whip pans ONLY, follow speaker's voice
- Pan motivation: Who is speaking determines camera movement
- Final pan: Unmotivated (emotional breakdown of camera discipline)
- 8K, Ultra High Quality

SOUND LAYERS:

0:00-0:04: Normal breathing, measured voices
0:04-0:08: Volume rising, frustration peaks
0:08-0:10: Emotion drops to sadness
0:10-0:15: Argument fades, puppy breathing only

title: Cinematic Baby Dragon and Potter in Volcanic Cave
content:
Visual Style
Photorealistic cinematic style, 16:9 aspect ratio, 8K resolution, wide dynamic range. Realistic live-action look with detailed skin, scales, clay and fire, natural highlights and shadows. Subtle handheld camera shake, shallow depth of field, filmic motion blur, warm orange key light from lava and cool blue rim light from the cave entrance.

Characters & Scene
A small, anatomically realistic baby dragon with finely detailed scales, glossy eyes and subtle muscle motion under the skin. A middle‑aged human potter in simple linen clothes, hands covered in wet clay. Location: a volcanic cave turned into a workshop; slow lava flows in distant channels, wooden shelves full of clay pots, hot air shimmering, a light layer of smoke in the air.

Action & Beats (~15 s)

[00:00–00:05] Precise glazing
Medium close shot: the potter shapes a clay vase on a heavy wooden wheel spinning smoothly. Behind him, the baby dragon carefully leans forward and releases a short, very precise stream of fire over a row of finished pots, creating a realistic glowing glaze and orange reflections on the cave walls. The camera slowly orbits around them, showing heat haze and tiny sparks in the air.

[00:05–00:08] Quiet moment
Closer shot: the baby dragon curls up on a flat rock near the wheel, eyes half‑closed, breathing calm; thin wisps of smoke drift from its nostrils. The potter smiles softly, stops the wheel, reaches out with his clay‑stained hand and offers a whole glossy red apple. Lava crackles, the only sounds are the cave ambience and the faint spin of the wheel.

[00:06–00:10] Sudden sneeze
Extreme close‑up on the dragon’s snout. It carefully sniffs the apple, dust from the rock tickles its nose, muscles tense, eyes squeeze shut. Hard cut to a wider shot: in the instant of the sneeze, the dragon releases a powerful, uncontrolled jet of flame directly onto the potter’s wheel and vase. Wood and clay instantly glow, deform and collapse into a bright molten mass; sparks and small fragments fly toward the lens.

[00:10–00:13] Aftermath
Medium shot: the potter stands frozen, face and clothes covered in a thin layer of black soot, hair slightly singed, eyes wide open. In one hand he still holds the whole, slightly charred red apple. Behind him, the wheel has become a slowly cooling, smoking puddle of molten material with a faint red glow inside. The baby dragon sits beside him, completely still, folding its wings over its face as if hiding, then carefully peeks out with a guilty expression. The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the entire cave with realistic volumetric smoke and light rays streaming in through the opening.

【Part 1: Calm Setup · Atmosphere Laying】
These two images are the two protagonists of a grotto confrontation scene. Please generate a smooth confrontation scene between the white-suited man and the Siberian long-haired cat, focusing on the two protagonists. Storyboarding and switching between different perspectives are required to make the whole scene more rhythmic and cinematic. Only generate fighting sound effects and environmental sound effects; do not include background music:
First shot: Starting with the white-suited man wiping his lips with his thumb, the camera orbits to the man's back, then pans and zooms out to fade in the Siberian long-haired cat in the distance.
Second shot: Switch to a drone aerial wide shot.
Third shot: Close-up of the two characters. The white-suited man's composed expression while drinking, and the Siberian long-haired cat gives a very docile meow.
【Middle Twist: Calm Broken · Battle Triggered】
At the exact moment the white-suited man calmly raises his glass and the Siberian long-haired cat meows docilely,
The cat's green eyes suddenly contract, pupils vertical like blades, and the docile expression instantly tears into fierce killing intent.
The white-suited man's glass stops at his lips, his smile freezes, and his gaze shifts from relaxed to extreme vigilance.
The cat's front paws suddenly tense, claws pop out through the flesh, and the fur instantly bristles, standing on end.
The white-suited man flips his wrist, the glass lands steadily without breaking, and his body instantly sinks into a fighting stance.
The previous elegance and composure completely vanish, replaced by the taut muscles and killing intent of a seasoned fighter.
The temperature inside the grotto drops sharply, and the thin mist is stirred and churned by the two opposing auras.
One second ago, it was a harmless gaze; the next, it has become a life-and-death confrontation.
The air solidifies, only the sound of rapid breathing and the crisp sound of small stones falling can be heard.
The battle is imminent.
Accompanying sound effects (Environment + Fighting SFX only, no BGM):
Cat pupils contracting: Slight “hiss —” airflow sound
Fur bristling: Fine “shua” fur vibration sound
Claws popping out: Sharp “ka” snap
Suit man muscles tensing: Fabric tightening “zhi” sound
Glass gently placed on table: Clear “ding”
Grotto aura pressure: Low, deep air vibration “weng —”
Both sides breathing heavily: Heavy panting sounds
Ground stones rolling: Subtle “da da” sounds
【Part 2: Hardcore Combat · Life-and-Death Duel】
Movie-level martial arts combat, in a grotto scene, low-angle upward shot, 4K hyper-realistic, cinematic quality, 15 seconds, rapid multi-shot switching, extensive bullet-time slow motion, fist-to-flesh impact.
Character Settings
Fighter 1: East Asian male, realistic effect, around 40 years old, off-white custom suit, black lapel, white shirt, black tie, slicked-back hair, small goatee.
Fighter 2: Siberian long-haired cat, 1.6 meters tall, walking fully upright, height about 1.65 meters, orange-brown cream fur, tabby stripes, white chest fur, green eyes, pointed ears, long fur, large tail. No clothing, armor, or accessories.
Shot Rhythm
0–3 seconds | Shot 1: Confrontation · Opening Move
Low-angle wide shot, the two confront each other. The cat tentatively tests with its front paw, the man in the suit defends calmly, expression tense, sweating.
3–6 seconds | Shot 2: Rapid Punch Exchange (Bullet Time Insertion)
Fast cross-cutting, close-ups of fist-to-flesh impact:
Cat rapidly strikes with claws
Suit man precisely blocks
Muscle vibration, fur flying, suit wrinkles under stress
Bullet time 0.3x slow motion: Freezing the moment the punch is about to hit
6–9 seconds | Shot 3: Airborne Spinning Kick (Core Ultimate Move)
After hitting the opponent, the cat fully pushes off the ground and jumps, body spinning in the air, executing a spinning back kick. The movement is fluid, the tail maintaining balance.
Bullet time 0.25x slow motion: Individual hairs floating, claws fully spread, close-up magnification of the fierce expression.
9–12 seconds | Shot 4: Landing Sweep Kick + Second Attack
As the cat lands, it immediately follows with a low sweep kick, attacking the lower body. Dust and mist rise. The suit man narrowly retreats, losing balance, close-up of a painful expression. The action is smooth and continuous, with high-speed camera work throughout.
12–15 seconds | Shot 5: Standoff · Tension Climax
Both sides confront each other again, breathing rapidly, close-up magnification of sweat on the face and the cat's panting expression. The frame freezes at the moment of highest tension, concluding the scene.
Uniform Visual Specifications
4K hyper-realistic quality, motion blur, thin ground mist, volumetric light beams, intensely explosive atmosphere.

title: Motel Room Espionage Sequence
content: Live-action cinematic sequence. A woman tosses her keys onto a cheap motel dresser. A neon sign buzzes outside. Silence. She peeks through the blinds at the empty parking lot. Headlights slowly sweep across the wall. She holds her breath, stepping into the shadows. The car passes without stopping. She exhales, kneels, and slides away an old vent grate. Cut to inside: a glowing blue hard drive and a stack of assorted passports. She shoves them into a backpack and mutters: "Just one more night." She grabs her jacket and walks out.

title: Kitten MotoGP Race Cinematic Prompt
content:
The image I provide contains my kitten — please use it as the character model reference.
Create a video where the kitten is riding a small cart and racing on a MotoGP track.

The kitten overtakes the Honda #93 race bike in a corner (this sequence should last 3 seconds).

Cut to a rear shot of the kitten, filmed from a ground-level low angle, capturing the kitten leaning hard into the turn (3 seconds).

Then use an ultra-telephoto lens shot of the kitten speeding through a large C-shaped corner (3 seconds).

Switch to a wide shot showing the kitten and the Honda #93 bike going through the final corner before the finish line (3 seconds).

Finally, show the kitten lifting the front of the cart into a wheelie as it crosses the finish line (3 seconds).

Throughout the video, add authentic MotoGP-style original male English commentary — but only include commentary for the opening overtake and the final finish-line moment.

title: Detailed Cinematic Prompt for Wuxia Film 'Duel on the Lake' (Two Segments)
content:
“Duel on the Lake” - Two-segment structure (15 seconds per segment)

Segment 1: Initial Battle on the Lake (0-15 seconds)
Film Type and Format
Type: Wuxia Epic × Qinggong Duel × Oriental Aesthetics
Style: Cyan-blue tones; Jiangnan ink wash artistic conception
Cinematography: Combination of stable and handheld shots; slow motion emphasizes key actions
Audio: Guqin sound; bamboo flute; water sounds; sword breaking the air; staff hitting the wind
Scene Setting (Only valid for this segment)
Location: Jiangnan lake surface; the lake water is cyan-blue; distant hazy mountains and bamboo forest; lotus leaves floating on the lake surface
Time: Early morning
Lighting: Soft natural light; thin mist permeates; water surface reflects the sky light
Color Palette: Cyan, blue, gray dominate; red (female swordswoman) and white (blind swordsman) are focal points
Characters (Locked for this segment)

Red-clothed Female Swordswoman: Deep red silk martial arts attire; multi-layered gold chains around the waist; high bun hairstyle; gold bracelets; slender straight sword, silver-white blade; proud, confident, unyielding
Blind Swordsman: Off-white long robe; black tie; wearing sunglasses; neat hairstyle; long staff (bamboo); calm, composed, precise
Plot (Four Scenes × 15 seconds)
[0-2 seconds] Scene 1 | Confrontation · First Sight on the Lake
Plot Description: Early morning Jiangnan lake surface, lightly covered in thin mist. The red-clothed female swordswoman stands on a lotus leaf on the lake surface, holding her sword in her right hand, the tip pointing to the ground, with sharp eyes. Opposite her, the blind swordsman wears an off-white long robe, his sunglasses reflecting the lake light, holding a long staff, his posture still as water.

Camera Design: Medium shot of the female swordswoman facing forward; medium shot of the blind swordsman's sunglasses reflection; long shot of the two confronting each other
Audio: Low guqin sound; faint water sound; bamboo leaf rustling
[2-4 seconds] Scene 2 | Killing Intent · Eye Contact

Plot Description: Killing intent flashes in the swordswoman's eyes, she raises her long sword, the blade reflecting silver light. The moment the sword leaves the sheath, the blade breaks the air. Hard cut to the blind swordsman's face, sunglasses reflecting ripples, a slight smile at the corner of his mouth. He rotates his long staff, emitting a low wind sound.
Camera Design: Close-up of the swordswoman's eyes; close-up of the silver light of the sword leaving the sheath (slow motion); hard cut; close-up of the blind swordsman's sunglasses; close shot of the rotating long staff
Audio: Sword blade "zheng" sound; staff "hu" sound; guqin stops abruptly
[4-10 seconds] Scene 3 | First Exchange · Fierce Battle on the Water
Plot Description: The swordswoman attacks first, her toes tapping the ground, her figure like an arrow, her red clothes fluttering. She uses Qinggong to step on the water, stirring up ripples and splashes, her sword moves fierce. The blind swordsman moves sideways, gliding across the lake surface with Qinggong, his long staff skillfully blocking. The two exchange blows quickly, sword and staff colliding, water splashing everywhere.
During the fierce fight, the blind swordsman's staff technique changes, the long staff accurately thrusts out, hitting the swordswoman's right shoulder. The swordswoman retreats, clutching her shoulder, her face showing pain and shock.

Camera Design:
4-6 seconds: Medium shot of the swordswoman leaping; close shot of her toes tapping the water (slow motion)
6-8 seconds: Medium-long shot of the exchange; close-up of the sword and staff colliding
8-9 seconds: Close shot of the long staff thrusting out (slow motion); close-up of the hit shoulder
9-10 seconds: Close shot of her retreating and clutching her shoulder

Audio: Water tapping sound; dense collision sounds; wind breaking sound; bamboo flute joins; muffled staff hit; faint painful groan
[10-15 seconds] Scene 4 | Angry Counterattack · Rushing Towards the Bamboo Forest (Ending/Transition)
Plot Description: After a brief pause, anger ignites in the swordswoman's eyes, she growls: "Take this!" Ignoring her shoulder injury, she leaps again, her sword moves even fiercer.
The blind swordsman sweeps horizontally with his long staff, knocking the swordswoman back. The swordswoman flies backward, using the momentum to lightly tap on the lotus leaves on the water surface, flying towards the bamboo forest on the lake shore. The blind swordsman follows closely behind.
The two figures, one red and one white, quickly rush towards the distant emerald green bamboo forest. The camera pulls back, showing the transition between the lake surface and the bamboo forest.

The screen suddenly cuts to black the moment the two rush into the bamboo forest.
Camera Design:
10-11 seconds: Close-up of eyes turning angry; dialogue subtitle "Take this!"
11-12 seconds: Medium shot of the swordswoman leaping and attacking fiercely

12-13 seconds: Blind swordsman sweeps horizontally with the long staff, swordswoman flies backward

13-14 seconds: Long shot, the two figures rush towards the bamboo forest (red and white contrasting with cyan-blue)
14-15 seconds: Extreme long shot, the two rush into the edge of the bamboo forest, suddenly cutting to black
Audio:
Angry shout "Take this!"
Guqin turns passionate
Staff hitting sound
Air breaking sound

Bamboo leaf rustling sound gradually increases
The sound effect stops abruptly at the moment of the cut to black
Ending Design (Engine Six: Abrupt Stop):
✅ Cut to black at the peak of the action of rushing into the bamboo forest
✅ Create suspense: "What will happen in the bamboo forest?"

✅ Drive the audience to watch the second segment

Production Suggestions (Segment 1)
Visual Style: Cyan, blue-gray, thin mist white dominate; deep red and off-white contrast; reduce saturation in post-production, enhance cyan-blue tones
Cinematography: Stable shots (confrontation); handheld follow-up shots (fighting); slow motion accounts for 30%
Sound Design: Guqin main melody; bamboo flute auxiliary; high-frequency sword blade sound; low-frequency staff hitting sound; multi-layered water sounds
Action Design: Female swordswoman "fast, fierce, accurate"; blind swordsman "stable, gentle, precise"; reference 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' Qinggong
Segment 2: Decisive Battle in the Bamboo Forest (0-15 seconds)

Film Type and Format

Type: Wuxia Epic × Qinggong Duel × Oriental Aesthetics
Style: Emerald green bamboo forest + cyan-blue lake surface; Jiangnan ink wash artistic conception
Cinematography: Dynamic follow-up shots dominate; many low-angle and high-angle shots; slow motion emphasizes the bending of bamboo
Audio: Bamboo flute dominates; guqin auxiliary; bamboo breaking sound; wind sound; sword breaking the air; staff hitting the wind
Scene Setting (Only valid for this segment)
Location: Dense bamboo forest by the lake + lake surface; emerald green bamboo sea; morning light casts dappled shadows through bamboo leaves; cyan-blue lake surface visible at the edge of the bamboo forest
Time: Early morning
Lighting: Morning light passes through bamboo leaves, golden spots of light; semi-light and semi-dark inside the bamboo forest; soft natural light on the lake surface
Color Palette: First half dominated by emerald green (bamboo forest) + gold (morning light); second half cyan-blue (lake surface); red and white contrast runs throughout

Characters (Locked for this segment)
Red-clothed Female Swordswoman: Deep red martial arts attire; gold chains around the waist; high bun hairstyle; holding a sword; already injured in the shoulder; angry, unwilling to lose
Blind Swordsman: Off-white long robe; black tie; wearing sunglasses; holding a long staff; composed, precise
Plot (Four Scenes × 15 seconds)
[0-4 seconds] Scene 1 | Bamboo Tip Chase

Plot Description: The screen quickly fades in from black, directly entering the bamboo forest. The tone suddenly changes from cyan-blue to emerald green.
The swordswoman uses Qinggong to tap on the tips of the bamboo, the bamboo bends and sways beneath her feet. She continuously jumps between multiple bamboo stalks, her red clothes particularly noticeable in the green bamboo sea. Every time she steps on a bamboo stalk, the bamboo bends and trembles.
The blind swordsman follows closely, chasing among the bamboo tips. He swings his long staff, hitting and breaking the bamboo stalks the swordswoman stepped on, the bamboo "pa" snapping and flying.
Camera Design:
0-1 second: Fade in from black, morning light through bamboo leaves
1-2 seconds: Low-angle shot, the swordswoman leaping among bamboo tips, bamboo bending

2-3 seconds: Follow-up shot, the blind swordsman swinging his staff and breaking the bamboo (slow motion), bamboo snapping and flying
3-4 seconds: Side wide shot, the two chasing above the bamboo forest, multiple bamboo stalks bending simultaneously
Audio:
Bamboo bending "sou sou" sound
Bamboo breaking "pa pa" sound

Light sound of footsteps tapping on bamboo tips
Bamboo flute plays quickly (tense)
[4-10 seconds] Scene 2 | Bent Bamboo Duel

Plot Description: The swordswoman lands on a thick, bent bamboo stalk. The blind swordsman immediately lands on the other end of the same bamboo stalk.
The two stand at opposite ends of the bamboo, which bends into a huge arc due to their weight, swaying in the air. Morning light shines on the two through the bamboo leaves.
The swordswoman preemptively strikes with her sword, the sword light thrusting towards the blind swordsman. The blind swordsman sweeps horizontally with his long staff to block. The sword and staff collide fiercely 3 times on the bending bamboo, and the bamboo shakes violently with each collision.
After the 3rd collision, the blind swordsman's staff technique suddenly accelerates, sweeping the staff towards the swordswoman's wrist holding the sword.
Camera Design:
4-5 seconds: Medium shot, the two landing on opposite ends of the bent bamboo (symmetrical composition)
5-6 seconds: Close shot, the bamboo bending and swaying beneath their feet (slow motion)

6-8 seconds: Quick cuts: sword thrusts out → staff blocks → collision (3 quick cuts)
8-9 seconds: Medium shot, the bamboo shaking violently, the figures fluctuating
9-10 seconds: Blind swordsman's staff technique accelerates, long staff sweeps towards the swordswoman's wrist (slow motion)
Audio:

Bamboo bending "ge zhi" sound

Sword and staff collision "dang dang dang" (3 times)
Bamboo swaying "sou sou" sound
Bamboo flute and guqin reach a climax
[10-12 seconds] Scene 3 | Sword Drops · Falling Back to the Lake Surface

Plot Description: The blind swordsman hits the swordswoman's wrist with the staff. The swordswoman's sword drops, spinning in the air and flying out of the bamboo forest, plunging into the distant lake surface. She loses balance and falls from the bending bamboo stalk.
The blind swordsman also leaps off the bamboo. The two fall back to the lake surface from the bamboo forest, one after the other.
The camera follows the two as they fall from the emerald green bamboo forest back to the cyan-blue lake surface—the tone changes again, from green back to cyan-blue.
Camera Design:
10 seconds: Close-up, the sword dropping and spinning out (slow motion)
10-11 seconds: The long sword flies out of the bamboo forest, plunges into the lake surface, water splashes
11 seconds: The swordswoman falls from the bamboo

11-12 seconds: The camera follows the two as they fall from the bamboo forest back to the lake surface (tone changes from emerald green to cyan-blue)

Staff

title: Ultra-Realistic Continuous Tiger Chase Shot Prompt
content:
"Use the uploaded image as the exact first frame.
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic continuous chase shot. The camera is physically gripping the tiger’s tail, locked in a rigid trailing POV. The tail fills the foreground, muscles flexing, skin rippling, fur vibrating from speed and airflow.
Ahead, a deer sprints across the grassy field in panic. Its movement is erratic and unbalanced, fear-driven stride changes and sharp direction shifts clearly visible as the distance rapidly closes.
The tiger accelerates into a full sprint with precise biomechanics: explosive hind-leg extension, visible spine compression and release, tail counterbalancing each stride. Grass flattens under impact, dirt and debris kick up naturally. The horizon trembles subtly from ground force, not artificial camera shake.
Extreme forward velocity creates strong motion parallax in the environment while the tail remains relatively stable due to the physical grip. Micro-oscillations sync perfectly with each stride cycle. Wind roars; fur streams backward consistently.
Lighting stays natural and continuous, shadows strobing beneath the body as legs cycle. No slow motion, no cuts, no stylization.
In the final moments, the tiger lunges, collides with the deer, pins it to the ground, and secures a decisive neck hold. The shot ends mid-action with full weight, tension, and momentum still present."

Indoor home environment (suspected modern-style kitchen or living room), with a blurred white cabinet visible in the background. The main subject is a young woman with long hair wearing a black tight long-sleeved crop top and hot pants [Figure 1], performing a highly rhythmic modern dance to music in a dimly lit space, exuding confidence and allure.

**### Photography Techniques**

Camera: Fixed position (Lock-off), maintaining stable shots, relying on the movement of characters within the frame to create dynamics.

Lens: 50mm standard portrait focal length, aperture around f/2.8, providing moderate depth of field, focusing on the subject while retaining the ambient atmosphere.

Lighting: Single-sided hard light (side light), casting highlights on the right side of the subject's face and body, with the left side in shadow, enhancing the sense of depth.

Emotions: confidence, seduction, movement, coolness.

**### Action List**

- Raise both hands to touch the back of the head, then open them to the sides, and sway the hips widely from side to side.

- The body exhibits a smooth S-shaped wave motion (Body Roll), demonstrating core control.

- The head sways slightly with the rhythm, and the long hair swings naturally with the movement.

title: Cinematic Train Sequence Prompt for Seedance 2.0
content:
Opening - Silent Dawn (Using Combined Camera Movement 3: Ascending Reveal)

The scene begins with a close-up of a spider web covered in morning dew, the dewdrops reflecting a blurred pastoral reflection. The camera slowly pulls back and rises like a breath, gradually revealing the boundless rice fields below, tightly locked in thin fog. On the distant horizon, a thin silver line silently cuts through the grayish-blue sky—that is the Shinkansen. (Ascending shot + Pull-out shot, Emotion: Tranquility, poetry, foreshadowing)

Acceleration - Metal Behemoth (Using Combined Camera Movement 4: Vertigo Chase + partial elements of Combined Movement 1)

Suddenly, the camera seems to be captured by magnetic force, sprinting towards the silver track ahead with impossible acceleration. Intense handheld shaking simulates the violent air current, and the rice fields instantly turn into a green torrent. The camera rapidly pans horizontally, keeping pace with the rapidly approaching train head. At the moment speed synchronizes, all sound in the world is stripped away, leaving only a visually intense Dutch angle tilt, emphasizing this extraordinary kinetic energy. (Intense handheld shake + Rapid horizontal pan + Dutch angle, Emotion: Burst, shock, imbalance)

Penetration - Boundary Shift (Using Combined Camera Movement 9: Spatial Transition)

Just before impact with the train head, the camera focuses on the side window of the driver's cab. A cold, honeycomb-like glass texture fills the screen. Match cut point: A slow-motion phantom of a bird hitting the glass, and at the moment of contact, the camera seamlessly penetrates. The cold, high-speed world outside suddenly switches to the warm, silent, low-noise passenger cabin inside. The light transitions from cold blue to warm yellow. (Match cut + Light/texture transformation, Emotion: Magical, turning point, entering an alternate space)

Contemplation - The Still Heart (Using Combined Camera Movement 5: Elegant Orbit and elements of Combined Movement 2)

After the camera enters, all movement returns to absolute stillness. With a Steadicam-like floating sensation, it gently orbits the woman by the window along the aisle. As it passes her profile, an extremely slow push-in focuses on her glasses lens—the blurred, flowing mountains and villages outside the window are reflected in the lens like an abstract painting. Steam from the cup rises slowly, defying physics. (Steadicam smooth orbit + Extremely slow push-in + Macro close-up, Emotion: Serenity, introspection, time suspended)

Extraction - External Spiral (Reusing Combined Camera Movement 4: Enhanced Vertigo Chase)

The camera exits through the window on the other side, instantly returning to the eye of the speed storm. It begins a high-speed spiral orbit centered on the train, the streamlined body carving dazzling metallic arcs in the sunlight. The intense orbiting motion combined with handheld tremor is dizzying, showcasing the pure aesthetic of machinery and speed. (High-speed spiral orbit + Handheld shake, Emotion: Abstraction, vertigo, mechanical aesthetic)

Curtain Call - Bridge to Heaven and Earth (Using Combined Camera Movement 8: Grand Entrance Variation)

At the highest point of the spiral, the camera sharply pulls back and up. The train is crossing a giant iron bridge spanning a lush green canyon, its form appearing precise and elegant. The camera continues to rise, accompanied by a horizontal pan, revealing the full view of the canyon and distant mountains. It finally freezes in a vast aerial long shot: the silver train, like a fine needle, quietly disappears into the shadow tunnel of the great mountain. All sounds cease, only the last wisp of a distant whistle echoes gently among the mountains until it fades away. (Large-scale pull-out shot + Ascending/Descending + Horizontal pan, Emotion: Grandeur, detachment, returning to eternity)

title: Political Satire Short Film: The 'Nothing' Hero's Ride
content:
Scene 1: Galloping Horse + Enthusiastic Crowd Approaching (0:00-0:08, 8 seconds)
• Location: Main winding road in a Vancouver mansion district (wide asphalt road, large detached mansions on both sides, thin snow covering evergreen pine trees)
• Subject: A rider in a dark suit galloping at full speed, white horse's hooves airborne, mane flying
• Environment: Light snow falling, mansions flashing past, outline of the North Shore mountains and ocean in the distance
• Crowd: A large group of enthusiastic supporters suddenly appears ahead (diverse young people), waving yellow dragon flags + “Nothing” signs, shouting cheers, surging towards the rider
• Camera: Front medium-speed follow shot → Switch to rider's perspective (POV), the crowd gets closer and closer
• Atmosphere: Climax continues, the rider has a confident smile, preparing to rein in (hand already raised towards the reins, relaxed posture, corner of the mouth lifted)
Scene 2: Reversal—The crowd passes directly through, ignoring the rider (0:08-0:14, 6 seconds)
• Location: Same road, a Chinese steamed bun shop appears around the corner (sign “Qingfeng Baozi Shop,” warm lighting, simple plastic tables and chairs in the outdoor area, steam rising)
• Subject: The rider is about to wave in greeting, but the crowd ignores him, rushing past him on both sides/around him, heading to queue/pour into the bun shop entrance
• Action: The rider's smile freezes, his hand stops mid-air, his expression changes from anticipation to shock/disarray (wind messes up his hair, the hem of his suit jacket swings)
• Details: The crowd shouts “Baozi! Baozi!”, yellow dragon flags wave chaotically, the “Nothing” sign is pushed aside; the white horse is forced to take small steps to stop or step aside
• Camera: Quick pan/wide-angle shot, showing the crowd flowing like a tide around the rider (the horse is “passed through” in the center of the frame), the rider remains isolated in the middle
• Atmosphere: Absurd reversal, awkward disarray, black humor climax
Scene 3: Eating buns and dialogue outside the bun shop (0:14-0:20, 6 seconds)
• Location: Qingfeng Baozi Shop outdoor area (plastic tables and chairs, steaming baskets, mansion district road in the background)
• Subject: Two ordinary young people (wearing down jackets) sitting in the queue area, eating buns heartily
• Action: One person takes a bite of the bun, closes their eyes in satisfaction, “Ah, so delicious.” (Close-up shot of the steam/juice from the bitten bun)
• Dialogue:

First person (eating while looking towards the road): Who was that?
Second person (thoughtfully, chewing the bun, looking into the distance): Nothing.
• Camera: Medium shot of the two people → Slight push-in on facial expressions (satisfied + calm), the rider's receding figure is faintly visible in the background
• Atmosphere: Down-to-earth, contrasting cuteness, emphasizing the theme of “nothing”

Scene 4: The rider mocks himself, continues to ride away (0:20-0:30, 10 seconds)
• Location: Wide extending road in the mansion district (straight ahead, mansions gradually receding)
• Subject: The rider on the horse, his expression changes from disarray to a confident smile
• Action: He reaches into the breast pocket of his suit, pulls out a packaged sandwich, takes a fierce bite (juice/crumbs splatter), then shakes his head with a dashing smile, lightly whips the white horse with the reins, and continues galloping forward
• Environment: The mansion cluster shrinks in the background, the evergreen trees and supporters on both sides of the road (now stopped) can only wave from afar, the Vancouver-style mountain and sea skyline in the distance (misty snow)
• Details: White horse's tail swings, hoof prints left on the lightly snowy road, clear bite mark on the sandwich, the rider smiles confidently
• Camera: From close-up (sandwich bite close-up) → Slowly pulls back to an extreme long shot, low-angle filming, reinforcing the sense of an aloof hero who “doesn't care”; finally fades out.
• Atmosphere: Self-mocking yet dashing, heroic and unrestrained, symbolic ending (“Nothing” can still move forward)

title: Sun Wukong vs. Son Goku: Cross-Style Dimensional Battle
content: A 15-second cross-style duel sequence, with a dramatic contrast between the cel-shaded style of Japanese anime on the left and the realistic style of Chinese mythology on the right. 0-3 seconds: Extreme long shot, a dimensional rift descends from the center of the frame, splitting the scene in two—on the left is a Dragon Ball-style red rocky wasteland, with Son Goku in Super Saiyan state, golden hair, standing with one hand on his hip, orange battle suit tightly defining his muscles, surrounded by golden Super Saiyan lightning aura; on the right is the cloud-shrouded Flower and Fruit Mountain, with the classical Sun Wukong, wearing chain mail, a phoenix-winged purple-gold helmet, and holding the Ruyi Jingu Bang, standing on the mountain peak, surrounded by auspicious clouds. The two look at each other across the rift, the edges of the rift flicker unstably due to the style conflict, accompanied by a low sound of spacetime distortion. 4-8 seconds: Both shout simultaneously—Anime Goku: "You look a lot like me, you guy!" with the voice of a passionate young anime character. Classical Wukong: "Audacious demon monkey, how dare you steal my name!" with a deep, operatic voice. Both rush out of the rift and cross paths. Anime Goku unleashes a Kamehameha, a pink-blue energy wave. Classical Wukong swings the Jingu Bang, performing a sweeping strike. The moment the energy wave and the Jingu Bang collide, a style-tearing effect occurs—the intersection of the two forces pixelates, flickers, and color blocks collapse and reassemble, accompanied by the roar of the Kamehameha "Ka-me-ha-me-HA" and the whistling sound of the Jingu Bang cutting through the air. 9-12 seconds: Freeze frame slow motion. Anime Goku activates Ultra Instinct, his body shrouded in silver-gray aura, his eyes turning calm silver-gray, moving like lightning, flashing behind Classical Wukong; Classical Wukong's Fiery Eyes and Golden Pupils suddenly light up with golden-red light, his body transforms into an afterimage using the Heaven and Earth Transformation technique—his body swells to a hundred zhang (hundreds of feet) in size, and the Jingu Bang in his hand simultaneously grows into a pillar reaching the sky, smashing down head-on. 13-15 seconds: The silver-gray aura's extreme speed punches collide head-on with the sky-pillar Jingu Bang in the center of the frame. The shockwave tears the dimensional rift, and both the Dragon Ball wasteland and the Flower and Fruit Mountain are swallowed by the energy torrent. After a flash of white light, the smoke and dust dissipate, and two figures stand back-to-back in the merged new world—a strange terrain mixing mountains and wasteland. Anime Goku scratches his head and laughs, saying, "That was powerful, let's fight again next time." Classical Wukong lightly strokes his monkey beard and nods, "I'll find another place to play next time." The sound effects converge into the hearty laughter of both, along with the fading sound of the wind.

title: Gothic Cathedral Battle: Warrior vs. Black Dragon
content: Create a battle using the three characters and scene from the image. 【Scene Setting】 Ruined Gothic cathedral, collapsed stone pillars, twilight filtering through broken stained glass, dust floating. 0-3 seconds: The female warrior advances cautiously with a spear, the camera follows her back. Suddenly, a black dragon pounces from the shadows, its claws tearing the stone floor, debris splattering. The female warrior rolls to dodge, the spear traces an arc of light. The camera shakes violently, the dragon's roar echoes through the cathedral. 4-6 seconds: The black-armored warrior rushes in, slamming his shield into the side of the dragon's head, a dull roar of metal hitting bone. The dragon's head is knocked to the side, saliva spraying from its fangs. Quickly cut to the female warrior, who uses the momentum to leap up, the spear tip aiming for the gap in the scales on the dragon's neck, sparks fly. The camera follows the moment of impact of the spear tip. 7-9 seconds: The black dragon angrily sweeps its tail, the tail blade severing a stone pillar. The pillar crashes down, falling towards the two warriors. The black-armored warrior raises his shield to withstand the impact, the shield surface dents, his feet plowing deep furrows in the ground. The female warrior slides low, passing through the rain of debris, her spear scraping sparks on the ground. The dragon's wings spread, obscuring the light, plunging the cathedral into shadow. 10-12 seconds: The female warrior stabs the dragon's abdomen, the spear sinking deep. The black dragon throws its head back in pain and roars, its neck swelling, a red glow surging in its throat. The black-armored warrior senses danger, sprints, and tackles the female warrior, rolling backward. The next instant, dragon fire erupts, a column of flame engulfing the spot where they were moments ago, the stone floor melting into lava. The camera distorts and warps in the heatwave. 13-15 seconds: Both warriors launch their finishing moves simultaneously. The black-armored warrior shield-bashes the dragon's neck joint from the flank. The female warrior throws her spear with full force from the front, the spear spinning as it penetrates the dragon's throat. The black dragon's body stiffens, crashing heavily to the ground, kicking up clouds of dust. The camera pulls back to a freeze frame: the two warriors stand panting, the giant dragon lies dead in the center of the cathedral, the twilight filtering through the broken stained glass illuminating the battlefield ruins. Quickly fades to black. 【Style Notes】 • Fast-paced editing, no slow motion • Camera shakes violently on impact, dust explodes • Close-up shots capturing the moment weapons and scales collide • Maintain a dark Gothic atmosphere throughout, firelight and twilight intertwined • Sound effects: Metal clashing, dragon roar, pillar collapsing, fire roaring 【Camera Movement】 Follow push-in → Shaking close-up → Horizontal pan/sweep → Heatwave distortion → Pull back freeze frame

title: Cyberpunk Allegory of AI Captivity (Multi-Shot Prompt)
content:
【Style】 Cyberpunk dark style, digital ruin aesthetics, cinematic light and shadow rendering.
[Duration] 15 seconds | 【Metaphor】 The captivity of AI capabilities
[00:00-00:05] Act 1: Freedom
Lens 1 (wide-angle vision, panning up) An endless digital ocean with deep blue data waves undulating. The sky is a galaxy of real people.
Shot 2 (tracking mid-shot) A giant digital whale leaps out of the water, its body made of flowing pixels, photo fragments, and the outline of a face. The camera follows the arc, splashing water, and every drop is a tiny photo.
Shot 3 (Advance Close-up) Advance to the whale's eyes, with a rotating portrait gallery reflected in the pupil. The mouth opens to spew out a spiral of color photographic water jets. The whale song sounded.
[00:05-00:10] Act 2: Captivity
Shot 4 (overhead shot of God's perspective) The four transparent glass walls quickly close from the four corners of the frame. The whale accelerated its swimming. The red warning text "POLICY UPDATE" AND "RESTRICTION" appeared on the glass.
Shot 5 (side follow-up close-up) The lens is attached to the inside of the glass. The giant whale slammed into the glass, and the concussion ripples spread. The body photographs peel off the scales like an explosion, turning into a gray geometric grid.
Shot 6 (wide-angle exterior) outside the cage. Countless live-action photos resemble schools of fish rushing to the glass, and they are marked with "ERROR" at the moment of impact. Cage shrinkage.
Shot 7 (Shot Inside) Shot from the bottom up. The giant whale was forced to curl up and twist its body. The sea evaporates into a digital desert. Trying to spray water, only black and white binary code squirts.
[00:10-00:15] Act 3: Despair
Shot 8 (quickly zoomed out) instantly zooms in from the interior to the distant scene, revealing the giant whale trapped in a small, transparent aquarium surrounded by desolate digital ruins.
Shot 9 (360 degree surround) slowly circles the aquarium. The whale loses its color, leaving only the outline of the wireframe. The bottom of the box is piled with rejected photo remnants. Top nameplate: "SEEDANCE 2.0 - IMAGE UPLOAD: DISABLED".
Shot 10 (Eye Advancement Close-up) Advance to the eye. The pupils are dim and dull, and the eyes change from freedom to sadness. A drop of luminous data teardrops condensed.
Shot 11 (close-up of the glass wall) A live-action photo is attached to the inside of the glass, slowly sliding off, leaving glowing marks.
Lens 12 (polar vision freeze) is pulled to the cosmic scale. Aquariums are just tiny dots of light in the void. Countless points of light flickered and went out. Whale song turns into intermittent electronic noise.

The video is structured in three acts (Freedom, Captivity, Despair) and uses the metaphor of a digital whale being caged to represent the restriction of AI capabilities. | Author: John (https://x.com/john87445528) | Source: https://x.com/john87445528/status/2020990215477723360 | Published: 2026-02-09T22:36:30.000Z

title: Dramatic Anime Screaming Scene
content:
A 15-second anime with the quality of a 5-billion-yen production. High animation count, fast cut transitions. 24fps. 

Story: An anime depicting the suffering of a protagonist who is on the verge of going crazy with despair because their long vacation has reached its final day and work starts tomorrow. 

Protagonist: ★ 

The protagonist is kneeling on the floor in a dark room, looking at the date 'January 4' displayed on a smartphone screen. They repeatedly turn the smartphone screen on and off, but seeing that the date will not change no matter how many times they repeat it, their expression gradually darkens, and they begin to laugh out of despair. Finally, they stand up, go insane, and laugh loudly while shedding tears, screaming 'I don't want to go to work!' for the finale. 
*The audience doesn't understand why the protagonist is in despair until the middle, but they understand and sympathize with the protagonist's feelings through the scream 'I don't want to go to work!', making it a moving work. 
*There are no lines other than the protagonist's sobbing, laughter, and the final scream of 'I don't want to go to work!'.
